name: Open Tools
description: A composer toolbar button that opens the current project folder in an external tool: VS Code, File Explorer, Command Prompt, Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7, Git Bash, Windows Terminal or WSL. Every tool is probed on this machine, so only the ones really installed are listed; a tool that is missing simply never appears. The list itself is yours: enable, disable, rename, re-argument, re-order, delete the built-in tools, or add a program of your own — all of it in one sheet behind the button, which is also the only place the list is edited. Launches never go through a shell: a fixed executable plus an argv array, with the project folder as one argument and as the working directory.
author: mfy

en.name: Open Tools
en.description: A composer toolbar button that opens the current project folder in an external tool: VS Code, File Explorer, Command Prompt, Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7, Git Bash, Windows Terminal or WSL. Every tool is probed on this machine, so only the ones really installed are listed; a tool that is missing simply never appears. The button is greyed out with a reason when no project folder is open, and a failed launch is reported as a notification instead of failing silently. The tool list is fully yours: open the button's menu and pick 'Configure tools…' to enable, disable, rename, re-argument or re-order the built-in tools, delete one, or add a program of your own (an absolute .exe plus an argv array that mentions {dir} exactly once). That sheet is the only editor — this plugin declares no setting, so the plugin manager has no second, raw-JSON copy of the same list.
en.safetyNotes: The plugin declares renderer.extension (one composer toolbar button) and notify (the failure notification). It asks for no file, network, agent, clipboard or MCP permission, reads and writes no project file and opens no connection. The one thing it writes is its own tool list, at %USERPROFILE%\.pi-desktop\plugins\data\mfy.pi-desktop-open-tools\tools.json, via the directory the host hands the plugin with pi.plugin.getDataPath(); the write goes to a temporary file and is renamed into place. Detection only stats a fixed list of install locations plus the directories already on PATH, and its result is cached in memory for one minute. Every launch is a child_process.spawn with a fixed executable resolved by the plugin itself, shell: false, an argv array in which the project folder is one element, detached + stdio ignored so the tool outlives the plugin, and a whitelist of tool ids the renderer may name — the renderer can never pass an executable path or a directory, so there is no command-line injection surface. The child environment is completed with the standard Windows variables (LOCALAPPDATA, APPDATA, USERNAME, …) that the host strips from the plugin process; without them a GUI app cannot start and Windows Terminal cannot find its own settings. Every completed value is either inherited or derived from the user profile and checked on disk first.

zh-CN.name: 外部工具
zh-CN.description: 在输入框工具栏放一个按钮，一键用外部工具打开当前项目文件夹：VS Code、资源管理器、命令提示符、Windows PowerShell、PowerShell 7、Git Bash、Windows 终端、WSL。每个工具都在本机真实探测，装了哪几个就列哪几个，没装的不会出现。菜单列表完全由你决定：启用、停用、改名、改参数、排序、删除内置工具，或者新增自己的程序——全部在那块「配置外部工具」面板里完成，它也是唯一能编辑列表的地方。启动不经 shell：固定可执行文件 + argv 数组，项目文件夹作为一个独立参数传入并作为工作目录。没有打开项目时按钮置灰并说明原因；启动失败会弹通知，不会静默失败。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 插件只申请 renderer.extension（一个输入框工具栏按钮）与 notify（失败通知）。不申请文件、网络、agent、剪贴板、MCP 任何权限，不读写项目文件、不联网。唯一写盘的是它自己的工具列表：%USERPROFILE%\.pi-desktop\plugins\data\mfy.pi-desktop-open-tools\tools.json，路径来自宿主通过 pi.plugin.getDataPath() 交给插件的数据目录；写法是先写临时文件再改名替换。探测只 stat 固定安装位置与 PATH 上已有的目录，结果只在内存里缓存一分钟。每次启动都是 child_process.spawn：可执行文件由插件自己解析，shell: false，项目文件夹作为 argv 数组中的一个元素、同时作为工作目录，detached + stdio ignore 让工具脱离插件独立存活；渲染器只能递交工具 id（白名单），永远递不了可执行文件路径或目录，因此没有命令注入面。启动子进程时会补全宿主从插件进程里裁掉的标准 Windows 环境变量（LOCALAPPDATA、APPDATA、USERNAME 等）：缺了它们 GUI 程序起不来，Windows 终端也找不到自己的设置。补的每个值要么继承自宿主，要么由用户目录推导，并且先在磁盘上核实过。自定义工具的 .exe 由用户在面板里指定，因此额外要求绝对路径、.exe 后缀、文件确实存在，且 argv 中「{dir}」必须独占一个元素；写错的条目被跳过而不是启动。
